chunks: What al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed us of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Zurarah, who said:

I heard Aba Ja'far عليه السلام saying: And he mentioned tayammum and what 'Ammar did. So Abu Ja'far عليه السلام placed his two palms upon the earth, then wiped his face and his two hands, and he did not wipe the forearms with anything.

Then he said, may Allah the Exalted support him: If his state of hadath is from defecation, he performs istibra' with three pure stones that have not previously been used in removing najasah. He takes one stone from them and wipes the place with it and throws it away, then takes the second stone and wipes the place with it and throws it away, then wipes with the third, following the places of visible najasah and removing it with the stones. It is not permissible for him to purify himself with one stone alone. Then he performs tayammum as we have described: striking the dust with the inner sides of his two palms, wiping his face and the outer sides of his two hands; and by that the ruling of najasah has departed from him, as we have stated before.
So all of this, its explanation has already passed in what preceded, and this also confirms it.

key_terms.أَحْجَارٍ: stones used for cleansing the place of najasah
key_terms.التَّيَمُّمَ: tayammum, dry ablution performed with earth or dust in place of wudu (ablution) or ghusl under certain conditions
key_terms.الذِّرَاعَيْنِ: the two forearms, which are explicitly not wiped in this description
key_terms.النَّجَاسَةِ: ritual impurity or filth to be removed in the process of purification
key_terms.الْغَائِطِ: defecation, the cause of the state requiring cleansing mentioned here
key_terms.حُكْمُ النَّجَاسَةِ: the legal ruling of impurity, which is removed through the described purification
key_terms.كَفَّيْهِ: his two palms/hands, used here for striking the earth and wiping in tayammum

ai.seo_question: How is tayammum performed according to Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, and what are the rules for cleansing with stones after defecation?
ai.summary: This report describes the manner of tayammum as taught by Abu Ja'far عليه السلام: striking the earth with the palms, then wiping the face and hands without wiping the forearms. It also discusses purification after relieving oneself using three pure stones and clarifies that one stone alone is insufficient, placing the narration within the fiqh of ritual purity.
